registered_addition_groups.rationale: These findings are bounded canonical SHA-256 review material and local sequence/schema validation for the phone recovery-need witness. The encode call hashes canonical witness material, set() only validates strictly increasing logical ticks, and the subscript assignment adds the final public-review digest to a newly constructed local mapping. The core installs no runtime hook, registers no attestation or verifier, retains no observation, mutates no live affect/goal/registry-owner state, starts no observation window, and grants no M3 or cutover authority.
